paragraphs: The XKR-S is the flagship of the X150-generation XK range, and uses the supercharged 5.0-litre AJ133 V8 — the most powerful variant of Jaguar's third-generation AJ-V8 engine. Fitted to the XKR-S from the model's 2012 introduction through to the end of the X150 generation, the AJ133 in this application is tuned for 550 PS and delivers the kind of performance that puts it firmly in grand-touring territory. The X150-generation XK was discontinued in 2014, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ133 engines for every XKR-S on the road.

cards.body: A 5.0-litre supercharged V8 fitted to the XKR-S from 2012 to 2014. Known for timing chain tensioner and guide wear — see the callout above. We replace timing chain assemblies, tensioners, guides and the water pump as standard on every AJ133 rebuild. Check Your AJ133 XKR-S → [link to quote form]
